issues.summary: Five faction Mods and two additional shared Mods are archive inputs rather than editable package directories.
issues.impact: Commander ownership and catalog collisions cannot be finalized from the main Mod directory alone.
issues.nextAction: Extract the archive closure into generated artifacts, compare Catalog IDs and Galaxy entry points, then copy only approved owned content into the Stage 02 package scope.

issues.summary: The lobby map and story transition map do not share the mission maps' explicit alliance initialization.
issues.impact: They may need separate launch/selection handling and must not be treated as ordinary cooperative missions by default.
issues.nextAction: Classify tarcade and tstory01 during map adapter design and exclude them from the first runtime MVP if their entry flow cannot use the approved launcher.

issues.summary: No runtime evidence exists yet for source map loading, commander activation, or AI ally state transitions.
issues.impact: Static discovery cannot prove the user-facing port works.
issues.nextAction: Run the smallest approved launcher path only after an owned map/commander package and runtime listener recipe are available.
